name: S6 - draugr's wish, granted?
description: Round 3's S3 captured your verbatim wish for what draugr's hands reached for; ticket 107's change 1 shipped - rimebreaker reworked from 25 power per distinct DEBUFF to 20 power per distinct STATUS (buffs included). (Change 2, a Poison rider, was built and measured 50+ points too strong, so it was held - not in this build.) Find the turn where you lost agency last time - is it gone? Does the lever that got built match the wish, or did it graft on something adjacent? NOTE: the pack said 'huldra' with no OS suffix; this uses huldra_v1 to match round-1/round-3 precedent.   [you: draugr_v2 | opponent: huldra_v1]
